# Offline test dependency

`schema-1.1.0` contains the SQL operations, manifest and MIT license from
[Dictionarry-Hub/schema](https://github.com/Dictionarry-Hub/schema/tree/1.1.0),
commit `e1c2bd73d7003f254ad135eeefbbed7b47f095b1`.

These files are for offline regression tests. Profilarr still resolves the
schema dependency declared in the root `pcd.json` from its normal upstream.
Do not edit this snapshot; update it with the dependency version and rerun tests.
